title: Cody's Utilities
description: This is a Utility mod made to allow players to use multiple TP commands.
body:
A Lightwieght mod build for Fabric that allows simple teleport commands to be used by players, to improve QOL.

**COMMANDS:**

/sethome <1-4>    – Save current location as a home slot

/home [1-4]       – Teleport to a home slot 

/delhome <1-4>    – Delete a home slot

/setspawn         – Set your personal spawn point

/delspawn         – Remove your personal spawn

/spawn            – Teleport to your personal or world spawn

/tpa <player>     – Request to teleport to a player

/tph <player>     – Request to pull a player to you

/tpaccept         – Accept an incoming teleport request

/tpdeny           – Deny an incoming teleport request

/rtp              – Random teleport (30s cooldown)

/back             – Return to your location before last teleport

/tpd              – Teleport to your last death location
